notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» : the father of Saduq, a relation link; the two co-transmitters are joined before «قالا»
«وَ غَيْرِهِ» is an unnamed co-transmitter with درست
the Imam «أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع» closes the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
«قَالَ آبِي يَا سَلْمَانُ» in the saying is the Imam speaking inside the scene: not a chain link
